extracted.name: Slow cooker bean chilli
extracted.description: Pack protein into your diet by eating more beans. They're a low-cost way to stretch this vegan chilli further, and it's easily made in the slow cooker
ingredient_lines: 2 peppers (a mix of colours works well), chopped
instruction_lines: Tip the onion and peppers into the slow cooker. Pour in all the beans and their liquid, then mix in the chilli powder, ground spices and dried herbs. Tip in the tomato purée and chopped tomatoes, then mix.
Cook on high for 3-4 hrs, or until the onion and peppers have softened and the sauce has thickened. Sprinkle over some coriander leaves to serve.
